units.source_text: 毋宁说，我是想从将眼前的姑娘作为欲望的对象来思考的状态中摆脱出来。

en.t: Rather, I wanted to break free from the state of thinking of the girl before me as an object of desire.

units.source_text: 应该把它作为人生来思考。

en.t: I ought to think of it as life itself.

units.source_text: 应该把它作为为了前进和获得的一道关口来思考。

en.t: I ought to think of it as a gateway for moving forward and gaining something.

units.source_text: 倘使错过眼前的机会，人生就将永远不会再来探访我了。

en.t: If I missed the chance before my eyes, life would never come to visit me again.

units.source_text: 这么一想，我的心就激动，

en.t: Thinking this, my heart grew excited,

units.source_text: 可一旦付诸行动，却又得手给巴，话儿难以流畅地倾吐出来。

en.t: but once I tried to put it into action, my hands faltered again, and the words would not pour out smoothly.

units.source_text: 这时，悬着一种万平屈辱的回忆。

en.t: At that moment, a memory of utter humiliation hung over me.

units.source_text: 我应该毅然张口说话，即使结巴也要把事情抖落出来，把生占为己有！

en.t: I ought to open my mouth resolutely and speak; even if I stuttered, I had to spill it all out and claim life as my own!

units.source_text: 帕木那种刻薄的催促，"结巴！给巴！"那种毫不客气的叫唤，在我的耳边旋荡，唤醒了我，鼓舞了我……

en.t: Kashiwagi's harsh urging, those merciless cries of "Stutterer! Stutterer!" swirled beside my ears, waking me and spurring me on...

units.source_text: 我终于把手滑向她的衣袋的下摆。

en.t: At last I slid my hand toward the lower edge of her pocket.
